definitions.gloss: to postpone; to put off; to defer; to kick the can down the road
definitions.explanation: To delay dealing with a problem, decision, or task to a later time. Often carries a negative nuance of avoidance rather than strategic delay.

examples.japanese: ⟦{決定|けってい}→決定：02701_kettei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{先送|さきおく}り→先送り：08030_sakiokuri⟧にした。
⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{先送|さきおく}り→先送り：08030_sakiokuri⟧にして⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{解決|かいけつ}→解決：00136_kaiketsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Putting off the problem won't solve anything.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{増税|ぞうぜい}→増税：12091_zouzei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{実施|じっし}→実施：03275_jisshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{先送|さきおく}りにする→先送りにする：24389_sakiokurinisuru⟧⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{固|かた}めた→固める：01929_katameru⟧。
examples.english: The government has decided on a policy of deferring the tax increase until next year.

notes:
Often used in the pattern ⟦{先送|さきおく}りにする→先送りにする：24389_sakiokurinisuru⟧ rather than {先送|さきおく}りする. Carries a stronger negative nuance than ⟦{延期|えんき}する→延期する：02517_enkisuru⟧ — it implies avoidance or irresponsibility rather than a planned scheduling change. Very common in political and business news.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先送|さきおく}り→先送り：08030_sakiokuri⟧: kicking the problem down the road
- ⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{先送|さきおく}りにする→先送りにする：24389_sakiokurinisuru⟧: to defer a judgment
- ⟦{先送|さきおく}り→先送り：08030_sakiokuri⟧⟦{体質|たいしつ}→体質：08243_taishitsu⟧: tendency to procrastinate (of an organization)
- ⟦いつ→いつ：00536_itsu⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{先送|さきおく}りにする→先送りにする：24389_sakiokurinisuru⟧: to keep putting off indefinitely

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{延期|えんき}する→延期する：02517_enkisuru⟧: to postpone — neutral; implies a rescheduled date, not avoidance
- ⟦{後回|あとまわ}し→後回し：07398_atomawashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to put on the back burner — similar negative nuance, slightly more casual
- ⟦{見送|みおく}る→見送る：04240_miokuru⟧: to shelve; to pass on — to decide not to proceed for now
